notes.title: 🛠 Reflections of the Void - Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]This patch brings several important fixes and improvements based on your feedback:[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]✅ Fixed a bug that prevented continuing the game after completing the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Settings are now saved properly and persist after restarting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Updated the disclaimer to more clearly reflect the developers' intent.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Removed unintended interactions with the protagonist's food (no more accidental clicks!).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🌀 Reflections of the Void — Demo Update Now Live! 🌀
notes.notes:
We’ve just released an update for the Reflections of the Void demo! Based on your feedback, we’ve fixed several bugs and added some quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Fixes & Improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed localization issue with the tablet after completing the test
[*] 
[*] Dialogues can now be skipped with LMB
[*] 
[*] You can now open the tablet using the middle mouse button
[*] 
[*] Added a pause icon
[*] 
[*] Mouse wheel now works for movement in the corridor
[*] 
[*] Fixed a bug with background music not playing properly
[*] 
[*] Fixed incorrect display of locked days
[*] 
[*] Added a hotkey tutorial at the beginning of Day 1
[*] 
[*] Removed interaction with the protagonist’s food
[*] 
[*] Added a demo ending to the endings section
[*] 
[*] Fixed a critical bug where pressing "Continue" after loading a save led to the death screen
[/list]

Thank you for playing Reflections of the Void. Your feedback is helping us shape the experience.

notes.title: 🎉 The demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
It’s been 9 months since the idea for Reflections of the Void was born — and now, at last, we’ve released the demo!

We’re truly grateful to everyone who believed in us and fell in love with the gameplay of Reflections of the Void.
Please leave your thoughts in the demo's review section — we’ll be listening closely and adjusting the game accordingly.

If your language isn’t available in the demo yet, don’t worry — it’s coming soon! (Stay tuned for updates.)
